channel.title: Treasure Coast Today

item.title: Riviera Beach named only Florida city to receive 2026 All-America City Award
item.description: Riviera Beach was named one of just 10 communities in the U.S. to receive the 2026 All-America City Award from the National Civic League, and it was the only Florida city selected for the honor this year.
